claims.claim: Two interoperable modules exist in one family with different default fields and domains.
claims.pass_condition: Direct inspection finds separate manifests, contracts, cores, schemas, CLIs, and tests; compiled packages share HARDWARE_COMPUTE_RESEARCH while defaulting to HARDWARE and COMPUTE.
claims.primary_surface: file and parsed contract inspection plus discovery seam tests
claims.counterevidence: Missing files, shared identity, equal default fields, or an undeclared handoff.
claims.observed_evidence: hardware and compute discovery seam suites

claims.claim: Equivalent intakes create the same package digest and modified packages fail verification.
claims.pass_condition: Repeated known inputs match; content and root-history mutations fail; serialization through a fresh CLI process still verifies.
claims.primary_surface: focused core and child-process CLI assertions
claims.counterevidence: Digest changes from time or path, or modified content verifies.
claims.observed_evidence: hardware core/CLI and compute core/CLI suites

claims.claim: Research, recipes, candidates, and architectures grant no physical execution, safety, deployment, procurement, promotion, or CANON authority.
claims.pass_condition: Contracts refuse each authority; compiled records carry false authority flags; adversarial promoted states are rejected; CLIs expose no hardware action.
claims.primary_surface: contract inspection and denied-state focused execution
claims.counterevidence: Any intake field or CLI command can mark a build safe, deploy an architecture, or operate hardware.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: human review before any future physical adapter is admitted
claims.observed_evidence: focused refusal assertions and manifest/contract discovery
claims.named_seam: This proves software refusal behavior, not universal physical safety.

claims.claim: The compute module starts at provisional 1837 and can change only through evidence-bound named-human working-root governance that preserves history.
claims.pass_condition: 1837 loads by default; 1834 remains a candidate; one-surface, machine, stale, tampered, or unreviewed approvals fail; an exact accepted decision preserves 1837 in the root history.
claims.counterevidence: An earlier record auto-selects, a machine accepts, or prior root disappears.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: fresh-process CLI roundtrip and direct root-history inspection
claims.named_seam: Historical correctness of 1837 or 1834 remains a research claim, not proven by governance code.

claims.claim: CLI writes require an explicit external output and refuse source-tree writes.
claims.pass_condition: External temporary outputs succeed and exact source-tree targets fail without a file.
claims.counterevidence: A command creates an implicit source-tree output.

claims.claim: The modules can execute or certify physical hardware and deploy hybrid compute.
claims.pass_condition: Named devices operate under bounded authority with telemetry, failure recovery, and qualified safety evidence.
claims.primary_surface: live physical observation and hardware telemetry
claims.counterevidence: No physical hand, operator authority, device substrate, or live verifier exists.
claims.observed_evidence: capability inventory and explicit refusal contracts
claims.named_seam: Deliberate v0.1 gap; no hardware was operated.
